consecutive_pair_bin: 2 if two or more consecutive pairs
state_definition.distance: Hamming distance across the four categorical state components.

estimator.conditional_count: Weighted count of each main number in historical transition outcomes.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.line_assignment: Deterministic rank interleaving: line 1 uses ranks 1,4,7,10,13,16; line 2 uses ranks 2,5,8,11,14,17; line 3 uses ranks 3,6,9,12,15,18.
portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
